personality: 8 Hand-Drawn / Journal LIGHT (Structure from 1 iOS-Native Clean)
personality_one_liner: A grounding, earthy, and tactile wellness journey with organic hues and highly refined e-commerce usability.

spacing.rule: Use generous iOS-style vertical rhythms (xl/2xl) but with softer Hand-Drawn rounded edges. Cards need 'lg' padding. CTAs must be sticky above the home indicator.

do's: Use glassmorphism on the bottom tab bar.
Use glassmorphism or a solid surface fade on the sticky 'Add to Cart' / 'Checkout' CTA containers.
Ensure text on glass surfaces is perfectly readable.
dont's: Do not use glass on regular list items or product cards.
Do not use glass on form inputs.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Discover natural herbal remedies and best-sellers.

states.loading: Centered sage spinner on oat background.
states.empty: No products available at the moment.
states.error: Unable to load the catalog. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Edge-to-edge scroll. Top hero banner with full-bleed image and top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse). Below hero, horizontally scrolling 'Categories' using rounded pill filters. Below that, a 2-column grid of 'Best Sellers' where cards use surfaceSecondary and soft padding. Keep text aligned left.

screens.name: ProductDetail
screens.purpose: Educate the user on the herbal product, show reviews, and drive 'Add to Cart'.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for image and text.

screens.layout: Large hero image area with a soft sage tinted background (brandTertiary) and the product image centered. Large Fraunces title. A small star rating row directly under title. Sections for 'Benefits', 'Ingredients', and 'Reviews' (using clean dividers). Sticky 'Add to Cart' CTA pinned at bottom over a glassmorphism base or solid surface fade.

screens.name: Cart
screens.purpose: Review selected items and proceed to payment.

states.empty: Your cart is feeling light. Discover our natural remedies.

screens.layout: Vertical list of items. Each item card has a small image thumbnail, title, price, and + / - quantity controls. Order summary at the bottom showing subtotal, shipping, total. Sticky 'Checkout' button at bottom.

screens.name: Checkout
screens.purpose: Complete the order using Razorpay integration.
screens.layout: Form fields for shipping details. Read-only summary of the total amount. A large sticky 'Pay with Razorpay' CTA at the bottom. KeyboardAvoidingView is mandatory.

screens.name: Orders
screens.purpose: Track past purchases and leave reviews.

states.empty: You haven't placed any orders yet.

screens.layout: List of order cards. Each card shows date, order number, and a horizontal list of thumbnails. A 'Write a Review' secondary button visible for delivered orders.

screens.name: Support
screens.purpose: Help the customer via Email or WhatsApp.
screens.layout: Simple centered layout. A calm illustration or large soft icon at the top. Two large buttons: 'Email Support' and 'WhatsApp Support' (use brand colors, do not use jarring native green).

screens.name: Profile

states.empty: Please log in to view profile.

screens.layout: Clean list view. Avatar (initials). Rows for 'My Orders', 'Payment Methods', 'Settings', and 'Logout'. Use Feather icons in tinted brandTertiary squares for each row.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Sign in or register for the app.
screens.layout: Centered layout. Soft background gradient. Large Fraunces welcome title. Single 'Continue with Google' button. No heavy forms.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use the Hand-Drawn / Journal LIGHT personality. Colors must be earthy (Sage, Ochre, Oat) and utterly avoid any shade of blue, purple, or indigo.
Do not use heavy shadows. Use border dividers or surface color changes (surface vs surfaceSecondary) to establish hierarchy.
Typography must be strictly capped at 500 weight. Use Fraunces for headings to give an editorial/handcrafted feel, and DM Sans for clean e-commerce body readability.
Sticky primary actions (like Add to Cart, Checkout, Pay) must rest cleanly at the bottom of the screen with proper safe area padding, and content must scroll behind them.

All images used as full-bleed backgrounds MUST have a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee text contrast. Text placed over images should be at the bottom 30% where the scrim is darkest.
In the Support screen, DO NOT use native WhatsApp green (#25D366). Stick to the app's brand colors (brand or brandSecondary) to maintain the organic aesthetic.
Icons should be 'Feather' - clean, line-art style. Do not mix filled and outlined icons.
Include the required states (loading, empty, error) using full screen flex:1 layouts for every data screen.
